## 04 - Daily Sales Report to Telegram
Every day at 21:00 (Asia/Hebron) or via Manual Test: reads the sales sheet, calculates totals, order count, average order, top product, top 3 and change vs yesterday, adds a short Arabic AI insight and sends it to Telegram.

**Credentials:** Google Sheets OAuth2, OpenAI API, Telegram Bot API.

**Setup:** set `telegramChatId` in Config, then pick the Document and Sheet in Get Sales Rows.

**Sheet columns:** Date, Order ID, Product, Quantity, Price, Customer. Dates: YYYY-MM-DD or DD/MM/YYYY.

**Test data:** the sheet must contain rows dated today and yesterday, otherwise the report says there are no sales today.

messageValues.message: You write short business insights in Arabic. From the numbers provided ONLY, write one or two short Arabic sentences with a useful observation (best product, change versus yesterday). Do not invent numbers or causes that are not in the data. Output plain text only, no markdown, no HTML.

nodeGroups.name: Load and calculate sales
nodeGroups.description: Reads the sales sheet and works out today's totals, top products and change vs yesterday

nodeGroups.name: Write and send report
nodeGroups.description: Adds a short Arabic insight, formats the report and sends it to Telegram
